figures.title: A two-dimensional array of points earned, students by assignments
figures.description: A grid with three rows and four columns. Rows are students with indices 0, 1 and 2; columns are assignments with indices 0 through 3. The value at row 1, column 2 is highlighted and labelled as pointsEarned bracket 1 bracket 2. A note explains that the first index selects the row and the second selects the column, and that both start at zero.
